dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: Nurgul! Are we still going to go to Almaty during the October break?

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Yes! I'm so excited. But we need to plan everything first. When exactly are we going to leave?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: I think we're going to leave on Friday the 4th of October — the train departs at 7 pm.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Perfect. And where are we going to stay? A hostel or a hotel?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: I found a great hostel near the city centre — it's going to cost about 4,500 tenge per night each.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: That's very affordable! What are we going to do on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: First we're going to visit Panfilov Park and the Zenkov Cathedral. Then we're going to walk along the Arbat — the famous pedestrian street.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Wonderful! And I really want to go to the Green Bazaar — can we go there?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: I'm going to put that on Saturday afternoon. And in the evening, we're going to find a good traditional restaurant.

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: On Sunday, we're going to take a cable car up to Shymbulak! But it's going to be cold up there — bring your warmest jacket.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: I'm going to bring my thick coat and gloves — I learned my lesson from last winter!

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: Good. And one more thing — who's going to book the train tickets?

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: You do it — you found the hostel! I'm going to book the cable car online this evening.

task1Items.question: Nurgul and Marat are going to leave for Almaty on Friday the 4th of October.
They are going to stay at a hotel in the city centre.
The hostel is going to cost about 4,500 tenge per night each.
On Saturday afternoon, they are going to visit the Green Bazaar.
On Sunday, they are going to take a bus up to Shymbulak.
Nurgul is going to book the cable car, and Marat is going to book the train tickets.

listenStatements.text: Found a hostel near the centre for 4,500 tenge per night each.
Wants to visit the Green Bazaar on Saturday afternoon.
Planned the full Saturday itinerary: park, cathedral, Arbat, bazaar, restaurant.
Warned that it is going to be cold at Shymbulak and said to bring a warm jacket.
Is going to bring a thick coat and gloves for the Sunday trip.
Is going to book the cable car online that same evening.
